responsibility: Declares the UTF support types, code-point tables, and encode/decode interfaces used by the front end. It defines the UTF code-unit typedefs, Unicode alpha-range table, validation and length helpers, and the public error-string constants shared by lexical and string-processing code.
same_name_distinction: Declares the UTF code-unit typedefs, alpha-range table, decode-status constants, and public encode/decode and validation interfaces used across the front end. Unlike gcc/d/dmd/utf.c, it exposes the shared data and function declarations but does not implement the decoding or encoding algorithms.
